aiOverview.content: The 98th Academy Awards will be held on Sunday, March 15, 2026, streaming live on Hulu and available through live TV services like YouTube TV, FuboTV, and AT&T TV. Coverage begins with the red carpet at 3:30 p.m. ET, followed by the ceremony at 7 p.m. ET/4 p.m. PT on ABC. Key 2026 Oscar Streaming Details: Live Stream: Hulu (even with ad-supported subscription), ABC.com, and the ABC app (requires authentication). Alternative Streaming: FuboTV, YouTube TV, and DirecTV carry ABC, and many offer free trials. Host: Conan O'Brien hosts the 2026 ceremony, held at the Dolby Theatre in Los Angeles. On-Demand: The show will be available to stream on Hulu the day after the ceremony. International Viewers:The 2026 Oscars will broadcast in more than 200 territories worldwide, check local listings for your
